title: 五官的立体度
description: 设计前，会综合观察五官的立体度、量感和整体风格。
description_en: Before designing, Lele considers the depth, visual weight and overall character of the facial features.

title: 量感与整体风格
description: 观察五官的大小、线条与整体量感，让眉形的粗细和轮廓与之协调。
description_en: Consider the scale and lines of the features when choosing brow thickness and contour.

title: 颧骨与面部轮廓
description: 综合观察颧骨的高低与面部轮廓，通过眉形位置、弧度与轮廓的调整，协调颧骨与眉眼之间的视觉关系。
description_en: Consider cheekbone height and facial contours together. Brow position, curvature and contour help balance the visual relationship between the cheekbones and eye area.

title: 眉眶骨与眉眼关系
description: 观察眉眶骨高低与眉眼关系，在尊重原有骨骼结构的基础上，设计眉头、眉峰、眉尾及整体轮廓。
description_en: Study the brow bone and the relationship between brows and eyes. Design the start, arch, tail and overall contour with respect for the existing bone structure.

title: 原生眉框架与毛流
description: 看框架、浓淡、毛质和生长方向，区分可以保留的部分与需要补充的部分。
description_en: Study the shape, density, texture and direction of existing hairs to decide what to retain and where to add detail.

title: 个人气质与审美需求
description: 温柔自然、清冷精致或利落英气，都结合五官、骨相、个人气质与审美需求定制，不套用固定模板。
description_en: Soft and natural, cool and refined, or clean and strongly defined: the design responds to features, bone structure, character and preferences, rather than a fixed template.
